services.name: Fly Fishing
services.desc: With another successful South Carolina tarpon season in the books, I was fortunate to experience some incredible moments that I will never forget. I offer tarpon fishing charters beginning in June and will continue to fish for tarpon until mid late October when they begin their migration back south. All of our tarpon fishing charters depart out of Georgetown where we have access to some of the most fertile tarpon fishing grounds on the east coast. With very little rainfall this year, I noticed a pattern shift due to the amount of baitfish that are normally found in the Winyah Bay vicinity.
